fishing: WHEN: early/moving tides (solunar ~6-8a/p). PASSES-BEACH: snook C&R, redfish, jacks Stump/Manasota. LEMON BAY: redfish schools Miserable Mile to Tom Adams, snook ICW/docks, mangrove snapper pier. NEARSHORE: mangrove/lane snapper, gag. Baits: live shrimp, pinfish, soft plastics.
redtide: FWC: K. brevis background in 1 Sarasota sample past week; not observed elsewhere SWFL.
bacteria: Englewood Beach GOOD (10 CFU); Charlotte sites clear.
